$:set -euo pipefail
printf 'COMMIT '; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'ROOT_README '; if test -f README.md; then cat README.md; else echo absent; fi
printf 'AGENTS_SHA '; git hash-object AGENTS.md
printf 'AGENTS_HEADER '; sed -n '1,12p' AGENTS.md
printf 'NESTED_AGENTS\n'; find terminal -name AGENTS.md -print 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'SOURCE '; test -f terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png && file terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png
printf 'SOURCE_SHA256 '; sha256sum terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png
printf 'PIL '; python3 -c 'import PIL; print(PIL.__version__)' 2>&1 || true
